storage_gc._note: scripts/hooks/storage-gc.sh runs scripts/onlooker-store-prune.mjs at SessionEnd at most once per interval_hours, detached. scratch_max_age_hours applies to session-trackers and lineage-baselines; retention_days to session-history, scribe/sessions, bursar/sessions and compass/sessions. Durable memory (historian, lineage, archivist, librarian, curator) and logs/ are never touched; historian applies its own retention_days. The last run report is storage-gc/last-run.json.
